items.title: Finitely many Taylor coefficients of a formal local map are controlled by one finite type etale-like modification
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: This is the Artin approximation control step: given a local O_{S,s}-algebra map sigma from a finite type scheme to a complete local ring, one must manufacture a finite type morphism (T',t') -> (T,t) through which sigma factors and which pins down every other factorisation modulo the N-th power of the maximal ideal simultaneously. The construction is explicit but genuinely novel: choose algebra generators c_i, clear denominators by a principal localisation of R, expand each sigma(c_i) as r_i plus a sum over multi-indices of length N, then adjoin one formal variable t_{i,I} per coefficient and impose the relation c_i - r_i - sum t_{i,I} f_1^{i_1}...f_m^{i_m}. The obligation that all factorisations agree modulo m_s^N is discharged only after seeing that any sigma' sends each c_i to r_i modulo that power, which is the load-bearing observation. Retained author proof at lines 11544-11568.
